title: a constrain fixture planted off the home box is still seen
intention: constrain's proofs judge the floor the same on every box, so a fixture planted off the home box is still seen by whatever reads it, and test_chart_constrain runs green on akienasus as on akiendelllinux.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: on akienasus test_chart_constrain's test_a_named_check_is_never_reported_unrun and test_one_red_check_does_not_blanket_the_report red (planted proofs reported unrunnable). constrain._ask_once on a proof planted on akienasus returns 'no proof file at <path>' from the home box's tester. On akiendelllinux all 27 teeth are green at e8f6f5ee8 (orchestrator).
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof means the same on every box, or a peer cannot lean on it); Law 3.
how: HELD FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR'S RULING before BUILDME (cast only, 2026-11-12). Outcome fixed, mechanism open: (a) 5243cf9dc630 lands, the floor reads seals locally and never asks the home tester, and the two teeth plant a sealed-red and a moved seal (its D3), so nothing crosses boxes; or (b) the floor's ask carries the planted proof by value, as 99ef0135b9b6 does for a deposit, which needs a tester verb that takes one (tester is cc_0's, out of these bounds). (a) is recommended: it needs no tester change.

clauses.claim: test_chart_constrain.py runs green on akienasus, all 27 teeth

decisions.text: D1: the two planted-proof teeth see their fixture on any box (under (a), 5243cf9dc630's D3).
